sample.selection: Round-robin first/middle/last, then consecutive distinct pages across DB-referenced originals; byte-identical source PDFs removed. Trade labels are keyword heuristics, not reviewed annotations; scan/hatch/font diversity not a certified representative distribution.

resourceAccounting.note: Components are measured, not a complete compiled encoding. Styles, clips, layers, full resource dictionaries, triangulation, tile index/placement and render validation are unfinished. Coarse bbox culling is not an approved first-view LOD. PDF sidecar transport retains the entire original as a conservative fallback, not a vector size win.

fidelity.note: 64px luminance SSIM tiles, two raster widths, ink threshold 0.005. Limited prototype intentionally omits images/patterns/layers/opacity/forms; failures are prototype gaps, not evidence the proposed architecture cannot work. Manual review only inspected a reference/prototype pair.
